text: {"assertions":["A signature mismatch bug was discovered in key rotation affecting clients pinned to v1 SDK, manifesting as verification failures against the previous key.","The root cause of the signature mismatch was an off-by-one error in a slice bound in crypto/keys/rotation.py.","The bug is reproduced by rotating the signing key while requests are in flight.","The fix involved correcting the slice bound and adding a property test to tests/crypto/test_rotation.py for coverage.","PR #4427 on branch fix/signature-mismatch-1 contains the fix for the signature mismatch issue.","The error rate for this issue was reduced from 3.6% to under 0.08% after the fix was applied."]}
